node.label: spinal muscular atrophy-progressive myoclonic epilepsy syndrome
node.definition: Spinal muscular atrophy-progressive myoclonic epilepsy syndrome is characterized by hereditary myoclonus and progressive distal muscular atrophy. Less than 10 cases have been reported. Treatment with clonazepam results in complete and lasting improvement of the myoclonus.
synonyms: hereditary myoclonus and progressive distal muscular atrophy
hereditary myoclonus-progressive distal muscular atrophy syndrome
myoclonus hereditary progressive distal muscular atrophy
spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy
